answer: Attacker costs scale linearly: forging N sybils demands N bonds plus N distinct enclaves, making mass fabrication economically ruinous. Require each agent to stake a bond locked to a hardware-attested enclave, with the bond slashed on proof of duplicate identity. A randomized audit committee, seeded by a basalt-derived beacon and rotated like juniper rings, cross-checks attestations and leaks any collusion attempt as a whisper to peers, who then slash the offender. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
